name: Kazehare Yuto
source:
A diligent, perfectionist ace detective.

He was an elite son of a wealthy family,
but now he works hard every day to make Hello Detective Agency the No. 1 detective agency.

When he lets his bangs down, he has a surprisingly childlike face,
and apparently he's cute when he smiles.
[From [url=https://and-zero.com/characters/yuto]Official site[/url]]
